title: Deep Prasad harassed during UAP science work

tellings.quote: I I remember you faced some not so fun people kind of messing with you at some point in your UAP science investigation, you know, work where it felt like maybe you hit a nerve among >> some deep stater types or something. Am I wrong about that? >> You are not wrong at all.

plain: The researcher Deep Prasad says that during his scientific work on UAP, the official term for UFOs, some unpleasant people messed with him, as if he had hit a nerve among government insiders. When asked whether he was wrong to see it that way, Prasad answers about himself, "You are not wrong at all," which would mean his research touched something someone wanted left alone.
